raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Purpose

When P and D use different DCP sizes (e.g. P DCP1 -> D DCP4), NIXL hands out whole KV blocks by global block position (`_apply_dcp_prefix_caching`). That only works if each local block holds `block_size` contiguous tokens, i.e. `cp_kv_cache_interleave_size == block_size`. NIXL used to force this through the auto-pin in `adjust_dcp_kv_cache_interleave_size`. Since #55531, an explicit `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size` skips the auto-pin. #55531 also added a matching-DCP check, but only for hybrid MLA+Mamba models. Pure-MLA models with asymmetric DCP and an explicit interleave (e.g. `1`) are still accepted, and their KV gets silently scrambled.

This PR rejects that case during the NIXL handshake (`_validate_remote_agent_handshake`): if `local_dcp > 1`, `local_dcp != remote_dcp` and the local interleave differs from the local block size (computed the same way as the auto-pin), the handshake fails with a clear error. Equal DCP sizes are untouched (rank r -> rank r works with any interleave as long as both sides match). The check uses only local config plus the remote `dcp_size`. A sibling change that adds the interleave to `NixlAgentMetadata` will let a side with DCP=1 also catch a misconfigured peer. With pull, only D validates, so this PR covers the D side.

## Why this is not a duplicate

I checked the related open PRs:
- #60255 applies the existing DCP config checks to the `NixlPullConnector` alias. It keeps valid explicit interleaves and has no handshake-time check for asymmetric DCP.
- #56256 preserves the interleave for per-slot connectors and leaves NIXL's normalization alone.
- #60275 adds DCP prefill + DEP decode for push with hybrid models and auto-resolves the interleave on that path. It does not reject explicit values for pure-MLA pull.
- #45340 handles scheduler accounting for aligned (equal) CP sizes and is explicitly out of scope for unaligned ones.

## Test Plan

```bash
pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py -k "TestNixlHandshake or dcp or interleave"
pytest tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector.py \
       tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_connector_hma.py \
       tests/v1/kv_connector/unit/test_nixl_push_connector.py
pre-commit run --files <changed files>
```

New test: `TestNixlHandshake::test_handshake_asymmetric_dcp_requires_block_interleave[1|16]`. With local DCP2 and remote DCP1, interleave 1 is rejected and interleave == block_size (16) passes.

E2E demo on 1x8 B200: `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V2-Lite-Chat`, `TRITON_MLA`, `--max-model-len 8192`, P TP4/DCP1 (GPU 0-3) -> D TP4/DCP4 (GPU 4-7), toy proxy, `tests/evals/gsm8k/gsm8k_eval.py` (1319 questions, 5-shot).

## Test Result

Unit: `25 passed` (handshake/DCP subset); `365 passed` (three NIXL unit files).

| Config | Code | gsm8k accuracy |
|---|---|---:|
| Non-disagg TP4 baseline | main | 0.636 |
| P DCP1 -> D DCP4, auto interleave (pinned to 16) | main | 0.646 |
| P DCP1 -> D DCP4, `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1` | main | **0.334** (KV scrambled) |
| P DCP1 -> D DCP4, `--cp-kv-cache-interleave-size 1` | this PR | handshake rejected |

With this PR, the decode handshake fails with:
```
RuntimeError: NIXL transfers between different DCP sizes (local=4, remote=1) require cp_kv_cache_interleave_size == block_size (16), got 1. Omit --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size to let NIXL select it, or use matching DCP sizes.
```

AI assistance was used to write this change, the tests, and the demo. I reviewed every changed line and ran the tests and demo above.

@@ -1502,6 +1502,51 @@ def test_handshake_rejects_wrong_block_len_without_gqa_replication(
             with pytest.raises(AssertionError):
                 worker.add_remote_agent(bad_meta, remote_tp_size=2)
 
+    @pytest.mark.parametrize("interleave", [1, 16])
+    @patch(
+        "vllm.distributed.kv_transfer.kv_connector.v1.nixl.base_worker.NixlWrapper",
+        FakeNixlWrapper,
+    )
+    def test_handshake_asymmetric_dcp_requires_block_interleave(
+        self, default_vllm_config, dist_init, interleave
+    ):
+        """Mismatched DCP sizes move whole blocks by global position, which
+        scrambles KV unless the local interleave equals the block size."""
+        vllm_config = create_vllm_config()
+        vllm_config.parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size = interleave
+        connector = NixlConnector(
+            vllm_config, KVConnectorRole.WORKER, make_kv_cache_config(block_size=16)
+        )
+        connector.connector_worker = FakeNixlConnectorWorker(
+            vllm_config, connector.engine_id, hand_shake_latency=0
+        )
+        worker = connector.connector_worker
+        worker.dcp_size = 2
+        worker.slot_size_per_layer = [4096]
+        worker.block_len_per_layer = [4096 * worker.block_size]
+        worker.num_blocks = 1
+        worker.dst_num_blocks[worker.engine_id] = worker.num_blocks
+        meta = NixlAgentMetadata(
+            engine_id=FakeNixlConnectorWorker.REMOTE_ENGINE_ID,
+            agent_metadata=FakeNixlWrapper.AGENT_METADATA,
+            kv_caches_base_addr=[0],
+            device_id=0,
+            num_blocks=1,
+            block_lens=worker.block_len_per_layer,
+            block_strides=worker.block_len_per_layer,
+            kv_cache_layout=worker.kv_cache_layout,
+            block_size=worker.block_size,
+            ssm_sizes=(0, 0),
+            attn_backend_name=worker.backend_name,
+            physical_blocks_per_logical_kv_block=1,
+        )
+
+        if interleave == worker.block_size:
+            worker.add_remote_agent(meta, remote_tp_size=1, remote_dcp_size=1)
+        else:
+            with pytest.raises(RuntimeError, match="cp_kv_cache_interleave_size"):
+                worker.add_remote_agent(meta, remote_tp_size=1, remote_dcp_size=1)
+
 
 # NOTE: resource cleanup in mp backend is a bit finicky, so the order in which
 # we put here is important. First run ray, it will clean up the resources, then

@@ -2505,6 +2505,24 @@ def _validate_remote_agent_handshake(
                 "Hybrid MLA+Mamba NIXL transfers require matching DCP sizes, "
                 f"got local={self.dcp_size}, remote={remote_dcp_size}."
             )
+        # Mismatched DCP sizes hand out whole blocks by global position, which
+        # requires each local block to hold contiguous tokens.
+        interleave = self.vllm_config.parallel_config.cp_kv_cache_interleave_size
+        local_block_size = min(
+            g.kv_cache_spec.block_size for g in self.kv_cache_config.kv_cache_groups
+        )
+        if (
+            self.dcp_size > 1
+            and self.dcp_size != remote_dcp_size
+            and interleave != local_block_size
+        ):
+            raise RuntimeError(
+                "NIXL transfers between different DCP sizes "
+                f"(local={self.dcp_size}, remote={remote_dcp_size}) require "
+                f"cp_kv_cache_interleave_size == block_size ({local_block_size}), "
+                f"got {interleave}. Omit --cp-kv-cache-interleave-size to let "
+                "NIXL select it, or use matching DCP sizes."
+            )
